note: Gate and step IDs are stable names, not an ordering. The order of work is the milestones; run 'continue'.

gates.title: Direction and decisions
gates.purpose: Settle the decisions that block later work. Agents prepare options; only the founder decides.

steps.title: DECISION: product boundary and first release (who it is for, the one job, what is out)
steps.exit: Founder decision recorded via 'decide'. VISION.md sections 'Who it is for', 'What it is not' and 'First release' are filled in and confirmed by the founder.

steps.title: DECISION: stack, hosting, data store and monthly budget
steps.exit: Founder decision recorded with a concrete value for each of stack, hosting, data store and budget; 'Decisions already made' in VISION.md updated.

gates.title: Foundation
gates.purpose: The repository is trustworthy for agents and for CI before anything is built on it.

steps.title: One documented command runs every test, lint, typecheck and build; kit.config.json checks lists those commands
steps.exit: A documented command runs the whole test suite; its exit code is 0 on a clean tree and non-zero when a test is deliberately broken; kit.config.json "checks" lists the real commands that must pass before anything lands.

steps.title: CI workflow runs the checks on pull requests and on pushes to kit/integration and step/**
steps.exit: A workflow runs install, lint, typecheck, build and tests, is green on the integration branch, and a failing step blocks; 'ci check' passes and ci.mode is set to "wait".

steps.title: Secret hygiene: .gitignore, .env.example, and a secret scan over the history
steps.exit: No secret in the repository history (scan output attached); .env is ignored; .env.example lists every variable without values; any hit is rotated and recorded.

steps.title: Setup guide: from a clean clone to a running app
steps.exit: docs/SETUP.md takes a clean clone to a running app with exact commands; a second session followed it from scratch and recorded PASS.
